title: Augmented lifts from a projective resolution into an exact complex are homotopic
statement: Let D be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], and let M,N be objects of D. Let P be a projective resolution of M: a nonnegative chain complex of projective objects with an exact augmentation to M. Let K be any nonnegative chain complex in D and pi:K_0 -> N a morphism. Suppose d_1 followed by pi is zero, K_1 -> K_0 -> N is exact, and K_{n+2} -> K_{n+1} -> K_n is exact for every natural n [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. If a,a_prime:P -> K are chain maps and their degree-zero components have equal composites with pi, then there exists a chain homotopy from a to a_prime. The terms of K need not be projective, and pi need not be an epimorphism.

source.place: Tag 00LS(2), proof comparing augmented lifts into an arbitrary resolution. The existing Lean proof generalizes the free-module induction to projective objects in an abelian category via ShortComplex.Exact.liftFromProjective; target projectivity and surjectivity of pi are not used.

proof.text: Put f=a-a_prime. The augmentation equality gives f_0 followed by pi equal to zero. Exactness of K_1 -> K_0 -> N and projectivity of P_0 give s_0:P_0 -> K_1 with s_0 followed by d_1 equal to f_0, using ShortComplex.Exact.liftFromProjective and liftFromProjective_comp. This is the degree-zero null-homotopy equation; no epimorphism assumption on pi enters.

The chain-map equation for f and the equation for s_0 show that f_1 minus d_P followed by s_0 vanishes after K_1 -> K_0. Exactness of K_2 -> K_1 -> K_0 and projectivity of P_1 lift this residual morphism to s_1:P_1 -> K_2. Rearrange its lift equation as the sum of the two homotopy terms.

Inductively, suppose the two preceding components satisfy the homotopy equation. Compose the next residual f_{n+2} minus d_P followed by the last component with d_K. The chain-map equation, the preceding homotopy equation and d_P squared equal to zero make this composite vanish. Exactness at K_{n+2} and projectivity of P_{n+2} produce the next component by ShortComplex.Exact.liftFromProjective. Its composition formula is exactly the next homotopy equation after rearranging subtraction. Homotopy.mkInductive assembles the two initial lifts and this inductive construction into Homotopy f 0. Homotopy.equivSubZero converts it into Homotopy a a_prime. The implemented proof is complete, including degree zero and zero objects.

from.place: Affine self-Tor computation: comparison-independence step for two normalized augmented resolution lifts, prior to tensoring their homotopy with the fixed coefficient map.

lean.statement:
theorem augmented_lift_homotopy
    {D : Type*} [Category D] [Abelian D] {M N : D}
    (P : ProjectiveResolution M) (K : ChainComplex D ℕ) (π : K.X 0 ⟶ N)
    (hz : K.d 1 0 ≫ π = 0)
    (hzero : (ShortComplex.mk (K.d 1 0) π hz).Exact)
    (hsucc : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (ShortComplex.mk (K.d (n + 2) (n + 1)) (K.d (n + 1) n)
        (K.d_comp_d _ _ _)).Exact)
    (a a' : P.complex ⟶ K) (haug : a.f 0 ≫ π = a'.f 0 ≫ π) :
    Nonempty (Homotopy a a')
